suggested_solution: Use the laptop while plugged in for heavy tasks and gaming.
Calibrate the battery every 3 months by discharging it to 20% and recharging it.
Keep the laptop cool and clean to prevent overheating.
Disable telemetry, superfetch, indexing, and other unnecessary features to free up resources and prolong SSD health.
Keep apps and windows updated, including NVIDIA drivers if necessary.
Consider purchasing an extended warranty and regular maintenance services from authorized HP shops.
